payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used to reduce data sparsity effects in neural machine translation (NMT) systems, including data augmentation techniques and word segmentation methods.

claims.text: Data augmentation methods, such as the mix-source method, are used to increase training data and alleviate data sparsity.
Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) is employed to segment words into sub-components, allowing NMT to learn translations with less data.
The VNBPE method is a simple unsupervised word segmentation technique that helps in reducing data sparsity effects.
